s01_process_domain_cardinality.message: Each process must belong to exactly one performance domain.

s02_process_focus_area.message: Each process must name at least one focus area.

s03_process_input.message: Each process must consume at least one artifact.

s04_process_output.message: Each process must produce at least one artifact.

s05_process_domain_class.message: The domain of a process must be a performance domain.

s06_process_focus_class.message: The focus area of a process must be a focus area.

s07_process_label_en.message: Each process must carry an English preferred label.

s08_process_label_zh.message: Each process must carry a Chinese preferred label.

s09_process_code.message: Each process must carry its structural code.

s10_process_source_page.message: Each process must record the page where its structure was verified.

s11_process_io_status.message: The I/O status of a process must be complete or pending.

s12_domain_definition.message: Each performance domain must carry a self-authored definition.

s13_domain_process.message: Each performance domain must own at least one process.

s14_focus_definition.message: Each focus area must carry a self-authored definition.

s15_focus_process.message: Each focus area must cover at least one process.

s16_artifact_category.message: Artifact category must come from the controlled list.

s17_artifact_label.message: Each artifact must carry a preferred label.

s18_artifact_source_page.message: Each artifact must record a page anchor.

s19_artifact_definition_status.message: Artifact definition status must come from the controlled list.

s20_technique_category.message: Technique category must come from the controlled list.

s21_technique_label.message: Each tool or technique must carry a preferred label.

s22_class_definition.message: Every class must carry a self-authored definition.

s23_property_domain.message: Every object property must declare a domain.

s24_property_range.message: Every object property must declare a range.
